# Beth Frankos Freelance LLC

> Operations consulting, business setup, and website services for contractors, nonprofits, and small businesses. Streamline processes, scale operations, and grow revenue.

Beth Frankos Freelance LLC helps small business owners, contractors, and nonprofits launch, grow, and thrive through operations consulting, strategic support, and affordable web design.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of services, testimonials, packages, and à la carte offerings.
- [Websites](/websites): Small-business website packages — Starter, Growth, and Managed Webmaster.
- [Book a Call](/book): Qualifying form and embedded calendar to schedule a strategy session.
- [Payments](/payments): Secure PayPal checkout for existing clients.
